summary: Iteration 3 (Final Build v1) verified. Backend: 73/73 pytest PASS (31 iter1 + 22 iter2 + 17 iter3 + 3 iter2 relaxed for iter3 spec change). Iter3-specific coverage: extended pro registration (phone/bio/service_area/salon/city/specialty_ids) with fresh unverified pro appearing in search, Founding-Pro promo (seeded Amara = slot #1 is_founding_pro/plan_type=unlimited/price=0/promo_expires_at≈+365d), 11th+ pro gets NO founding promo, GET /subscriptions/me pricing shape (customer $8/$76.80, pro $19/$182.40, yearly_savings_pct=20, founding_pro_days_left populated), POST /subscriptions/subscribe yearly for customer=76.8 & pro=182.4 including reconciliation on GET, 400 when billing_interval missing for Unlimited, founding pro re-subscribe returns note 'Founding Pro promo — no charge until it expires' and does NOT overwrite sub, onboarding-status gating (400 until specialty+availability both set, then 200 flips onboarding_completed), POST /customer-ratings pro-only (403 for customer), duplicate blocked (400), not-completed blocked (400), 3 flagged ratings restrict customer, restricted customer POST /bookings returns 403 with 'temporarily restricted', admin /customer-flags lists with recent_flags[≤5], admin lift resets flag_count/booking_restricted=false and sends restriction_lifted notification, restricted customer can book after lift, POST /reports OK & self-report=400, featured-stylist cache returns same pro across calls within week. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): /welcome renders welcome-customer, welcome-braider, welcome-existing CTAs; login 'New here?' -> /welcome; Amara login lands on /pro/dashboard directly (onboarding_completed=true seeded); pro-signout -> /welcome; Sara login -> /home; admin login -> /admin/verifications with 'Pro verifications' + 'Customer flags' tab bar working (customer-flags shows 'No restricted customers right now.'); Extended pro register form shows testIDs reg-name/email/password/phone/bio/service-area/salon (city field omitted in UI — merged into service-area per copy), 6 specialty chips present; successful pro register routes to /pro/onboarding NOT /pro/dashboard; Subscription screen for fresh non-founding pro shows Monthly/Yearly toggle with 'save 20%', pro yearly $182.4/yr, standard 'Current plan' + Unlimited 'Switch to Unlimited yearly' CTA. Founding banner only present for Amara (verified separately via GET /subscriptions/me founding_pro_days_left>300). Cosmetic: RN warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still emitted (iter1/2 known).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1256 lines — please split into routers (auth, subscriptions, bookings, ratings, admin, verification, featured) post-MVP. Growing monolith risks merge conflicts.

Iteration 3 correctly reversed iter2's pending-pro-exclusion in /search and /hairstyles/{id}/hairdressers (verification is now optional per spec). Old iter2 tests updated in place to assert the new relaxed behavior (kept as regression coverage).
founding_pro_slot uses pro_count post-insert (so slot values are 1..10 inclusive). Matches spec. Consider an atomic find_and_modify counter to remove race window if signup traffic ever concurrent.
get_active_subscription auto-expires the founding promo when promo_expires_at passes and downgrades user.plan to standard — good.
admin/customer-flags returns recent_flags[]≤5 with phone forcibly nulled. Good privacy discipline.

featured-stylist caches by ISO week_start; test verified same pro across calls in the same request loop. The weighted-rotation logic (rating + inverse-recency) is only exercised on the first call of a fresh week — worth an end-of-week manual sanity check when tick happens.
POST /reports has no rate limit — an abusive user could spam reports. Consider deduping (reporter_id, reported_user_id) or throttling for prod.
